extracted.name: Sweet potato wedges
extracted.description: Rustle up some sweet potato wedges as a super-simple snack or side dish. They only require three ingredients and are sure to be a hit with the whole family
ingredient_lines: 1 tbsp finely chopped fresh thyme or rosemary
instruction_lines: Heat the oven to 220C/200C fan/gas 7. Cut off and discard the ends of the potatoes, halve, then cut each half into long wedges.
Tip the wedges onto a large baking tray. Drizzle over the oil, sprinkle over the thyme or rosemary and plenty of seasoning, then toss to coat.
Cook in the oven for 15 mins, then turn the wedges over and cook for 15 mins more until golden and tender. Serve.
